characters.name: Kjærringdatteren
characters.description: A young woman with an average build, wearing simple peasant clothing typical of Nordic folklore, consisting of a long dress and apron. She has unruly brown hair often tied back loosely. Her facial expressions are often somber or distressed, reflecting her unfortunate fate. She is depicted in a modest farmhouse setting, surrounded by snakes and toads that pour out of an old chest, symbolizing the misfortune brought upon her due to the creature's curse.

characters.name: Hanen
characters.description: A vibrant rooster with colorful plumage, predominantly red and gold, representing vitality and determination. The rooster's eyes are sharp, and it carries itself with a proud and urgent demeanor as it embarks on a quest to save its partner. The setting includes a diverse backdrop of village characters and natural elements, such as streams and trees, which Hanen interacts with in a determined and frantic manner.

characters.name: Hønen
characters.description: A hen with soft, earthy brown feathers, appearing fragile as she chokes on a nut shell. Her wings flap desperately, and her eyes are wide with distress. She is found in the lush nut forest, where nut trees surround her as she struggles.

characters.name: Kulbrænderen
characters.description: A rugged, kind-hearted man dressed in work-worn clothes suitable for charcoal burning, dusty and stained with soot. He has a strong build and a beard peppered with ash. His expression is one of sympathy, as he finally decides to help Hanen by giving the needed coal. His setting is a simple and practical charcoal-burning area with stacks of blackened wood.

characters.name: Jomfru Maria
characters.description: A serene and compassionate figure, depicted in flowing robes of blue and white, exuding an aura of grace and benevolence. Her expression is gentle yet firm, reflecting her position as an intermediary in Hanen's quest. She is frequently surrounded by a soft, divine light and depicted in a celestial, tranquil environment.
